verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents security/consent mechanisms (SPT usage limits and revocation, human-approval tokens for MCP actions, RAK scoping, card-network Agent Pay/Intelligent Commerce programs) but nowhere states explicit fraud, chargeback, or liability allocation rules — i.e., who eats a loss when an agent-initiated transaction is disputed. Community commentary even flags that authorization/liability questions ('did anyone authorize this') are unresolved and that docs are 'sparse' on end-to-end mechanics, and no citation defines merchant vs. Stripe vs. network liability for agent-driven chargebacks.
